        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Handles both sign-in and sign-up flows seamlessly\n * Validates next parameter to prevent open redirects\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton({ next }: { next?: string }) {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const supabase = createClient();\n\n    try {\n      const callbackUrl = new URL(&#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/callback&#96;);\n      if (next) {\n        // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects (defense-in-depth)\n        const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, window.location.origin);\n        if (validatedNext) {\n          // Properly encode the next parameter - it may contain query parameters itself\n          callbackUrl.searchParams.set(\"next\", validatedNext);\n        }\n      }\n\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: \"google\",\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: callbackUrl.toString(),\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error(\"Google OAuth error:\", error);\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n      // Note: User will be redirected to Google, so we don't reset loading state here\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Unexpected error:\", error);\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Validates that a redirect URL is safe (same-origin or relative path)\n * Prevents open redirect vulnerabilities by rejecting external URLs\n * @param url - The URL to validate (can be relative path or absolute URL)\n * @param origin - The origin of the current request\n * @returns The validated safe path, or null if validation fails\n */\nexport function validateRedirectUrl(url: string | null, origin: string): string | null {\n  if (!url) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Reject empty strings\n  if (url.trim() === \"\") {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Allow relative paths (starting with /)\n  if (url.startsWith(\"/\")) {\n    // Ensure it doesn't contain protocol-relative URLs or other schemes\n    if (url.includes(\"://\") || url.startsWith(\"//\") || url.startsWith(\"javascript:\")) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    return url;\n  }\n\n  // For absolute URLs, check if they're same-origin\n  try {\n    const urlObj = new URL(url, origin);\n    const originObj = new URL(origin);\n\n    // Reject if protocol doesn't match (http vs https)\n    if (urlObj.protocol !== originObj.protocol) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Reject if host doesn't match\n    if (urlObj.host !== originObj.host) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Return the pathname + search + hash (same-origin URL is safe)\n    return urlObj.pathname + urlObj.search + urlObj.hash;\n  } catch {\n    // Invalid URL format\n    return null;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Creates a success redirect URL\n * @param request - The NextRequest object\n * @param next - Optional next parameter to redirect to after success\n * @returns URL object for redirect\n */\nexport function createSuccessUrl(request: NextRequest, next?: string | null): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n\n  if (next) {\n    // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n    const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, request.nextUrl.origin);\n    if (validatedNext) {\n      // Parse the redirect URL to handle query parameters and hash properly\n      const redirectUrl = new URL(validatedNext, request.nextUrl.origin);\n      url.pathname = redirectUrl.pathname;\n      url.search = redirectUrl.search;\n      url.hash = redirectUrl.hash;\n      return url;\n    }\n  }\n\n  url.pathname = DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n  url.search = \"\"; // Clear any existing search params\n  url.hash = \"\"; // Clear any existing hash\n  return url;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates a redirect response with cookies copied from supabaseResponse\n * Preserves all cookie options (httpOnly, secure, sameSite, etc.)\n */",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# Tappka\n\nTappka as the app all-in-one web app for Tiimiakatemia Prague.\n\n## Features\n\n- [ ] Authentication\n- [ ] Room booking\n- [ ] Essay Bank\n\n# Links\n\n## Publicly available\n- [Tappka](https://tiimi.cz)\n- [Tappka preview](https://preview.tiimi.cz)\n\n## Locally available when running the project\n- [Tappka locally](http://localhost:3000)\n- [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323)\n- [Supabase mail locally](http://localhost:54324)\n\n## Other links\n\n- [Blacksmith](https://app.blacksmith.sh/tiimiakatemiapragueit/runs/jobs) - CI/CD for the project\n- [Supabase](https://supabase.comorg/zjdqjjekgwwysjkouxpf) - Database for the project\n- [Vercel](https://vercel.com/spirit-of-taps-projects/tappka) - Hosting for the project\n- [Cloudflare DNS](https://dash.cloudflare.com/09d0b565479ef597d4c1bfa2062078b5/tiimi.cz/dns/records) - DNS for the project\n- [Axiom](https://app.axiom.co/spirit-of-tap-9eje) - Logging for the project\n\n# Language\n\nThe project is written in english and will be written in english for better llm compatibility.\nAll czech should be just in localization files.\n\n# Local Development\n\n## Setup\n\n1. Install git if already not installed - https://git-scm.com/install/\n2. Install docker if already not installed - https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/\n2. Install node.js v24.x with pnpm 10.x if already not installed - https://nodejs.org/en/download/\n3. Install pnpm v10.x if you didn't choose it in the previous step\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install -g pnpm@10.28.1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. Clone the repository \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit clone https://github.com/tappka/tappka.git\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n5. Navigate to the project directory - \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd tappka\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Running the project after setup\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\npnpm install\npnpm dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe project will be available at [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)\n\n\n# Supabase\n\nSupabase database is developed locally and synced automatically whenever pushed. See [.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml](.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml) for more details.\nSupabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.\nMake sure that the project can run without setting up any environment variables, this is so that we can get new T's to start vibecoding without them giving up.",

        "contents": "/**\n * GET /r/[code]\n * Short URL redirect for QR codes\n * - If user is logged in -&gt; reservations/[code]/qr\n * - If not logged in -&gt; /rezervace/[code]\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: RouteParams) {\n  const { code } = await params;\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Check if user is logged in\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (user) {\n    // Logged in -&gt; redirect to quick status page\n    const url = new URL(&#96;/reservations/${code}/quick&#96;, request.url);\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  } else {\n    // Not logged in -&gt; redirect to public page\n    const url = new URL(&#96;/rezervace/${code}&#96;, request.url);\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "&lt;p className=\"font-quote\"&gt;Pacifico text&lt;/p&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Typografická hierarchie\n\n| Element | Font | Velikost | Příklad použití |\n|---------|------|----------|-----------------|\n| H1 | Poppins Bold | &#96;text-5xl&#96; | Logo \"Tappka\" na landing |\n| H2 | Poppins Bold | &#96;text-3xl&#96; | \"Vítej, jméno!\" na dashboardu |\n| H3 | Poppins Bold | &#96;text-2xl&#96; | Titulky formulářů |\n| Body | Roboto | &#96;text-base&#96; | Běžný text |\n| Small | Roboto | &#96;text-sm&#96; | Popisky, nápověda |\n| XS | Roboto | &#96;text-xs&#96; | Footer, metadata |\n\n---\n\n## Komponenty UI\n\n### shadcn/ui konfigurace\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"style\": \"new-york\",\n  \"rsc\": true,\n  \"tailwind\": {\n    \"baseColor\": \"neutral\",\n    \"cssVariables\": true\n  },\n  \"iconLibrary\": \"lucide\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Tlačítka (Button)\n\n**Varianty:**\n- &#96;default&#96; - TAP Red pozadí, bílý text\n- &#96;secondary&#96; - TAP Brown pozadí\n- &#96;outline&#96; - průhledné s okrajem\n- &#96;ghost&#96; - bez pozadí, hover efekt\n- &#96;destructive&#96; - červené pro nebezpečné akce\n- &#96;link&#96; - vypadá jako odkaz\n\n**Velikosti:**\n- &#96;xs&#96;, &#96;sm&#96;, &#96;default&#96;, &#96;lg&#96;\n- &#96;icon&#96;, &#96;icon-xs&#96;, &#96;icon-sm&#96;, &#96;icon-lg&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n&lt;Button&gt;Primární akce&lt;/Button&gt;\n&lt;Button variant=\"outline\"&gt;Sekundární&lt;/Button&gt;\n&lt;Button variant=\"ghost\" size=\"sm\"&gt;Malé ghost&lt;/Button&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Inputy\n\n- Výška: &#96;h-12&#96; pro formuláře, &#96;h-9&#96; default\n- Border radius: &#96;rounded-md&#96;\n- Focus: TAP Red ring\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n&lt;Input className=\"h-12 text-base\" /&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Karty (Card)\n\n- Bílé pozadí (card color)\n- Jemný stín: &#96;shadow-sm&#96;\n- Border radius: &#96;rounded-xl&#96;\n- Padding: &#96;px-6 py-6&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n&lt;Card&gt;\n  &lt;CardHeader&gt;\n    &lt;CardTitle&gt;Titulek&lt;/CardTitle&gt;\n    &lt;CardDescription&gt;Popis&lt;/CardDescription&gt;\n  &lt;/CardHeader&gt;\n  &lt;CardContent&gt;Obsah&lt;/CardContent&gt;\n&lt;/Card&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Layout vzory\n\n### Auth stránky (Landing, Sign-up, Verify)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ [Header - ThemeSwitcher vpravo]     │\n├─────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                     │\n│           Logo \"Tappka\"             │",

        "contents": "interface IssueReportButtonProps {\n;\n}\n\nconst ISSUE_TYPES: { type: IssueType; label: string; icon: React.ElementType; description: string }[] = [\n  {\n    type: \"locked\",\n    label: \"Zamčená místnost\",\n    icon: Lock,\n    description: \"Nedá se dostat dovnitř\",\n  },\n  {\n    type: \"mess\",\n    label: \"Nepořádek\",\n    icon: Trash2,\n    description: \"Někdo nechal nepořádek\",\n  },\n  {\n    type: \"technical\",\n    label: \"Technický problém\",\n    icon: Wrench,\n    description: \"Něco nefunguje\",\n  },\n  {\n    type: \"other\",\n    label: \"Jiné\",\n    icon: HelpCircle,\n    description: \"Jiný problém\",\n  },\n];\n\n/**\n * Button and dialog for reporting room issues\n */\nexport function IssueReportButton({ roomId }: IssueReportButtonProps) {\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState&lt;IssueType | null&gt;(null);\n  const [description, setDescription] = useState(\"\");\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n\n  const handleSubmit = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!selectedType) {\n      setError(\"Vyber typ problému\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(\"/api/room-issues\", {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          room_id: roomId,\n          issue_type: selectedType,\n          description: description.trim() || null,\n        }),\n      });\n\n      const result = await response.json();\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(result.error || \"Nepodařilo se nahlásit problém\");\n      }\n\n      // Success\n      setOpen(false);\n      setSelectedType(null);\n      setDescription(\"\");\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : \"Něco se pokazilo\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}&gt;\n}",

                  "lineNumber": 14177,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Supabase Configuration Changes\\n\\nUpdate [&amp;#96;supabase/config.toml&amp;#96;](supabase/config.toml):\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;toml\\n[auth]\\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\\n\\n[auth.email]\\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\\n\\n[auth.external.google]\\nenabled = true\\nclient_id = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\\\"\\nsecret = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\\\"\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\\n\\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\\n\\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; matches current auth.user.id\\n- **Access Active**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;\\n- **User Role**: Read &amp;#96;profiles.role&amp;#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\\n\\nThis approach:\\n\\n- Keeps [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Supabase Configuration Changes\\n\\nUpdate [&amp;#96;supabase/config.toml&amp;#96;](supabase/config.toml):\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;toml\\n[auth]\\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\\n\\n[auth.email]\\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\\n\\n[auth.external.google]\\nenabled = true\\nclient_id = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\\\"\\nsecret = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\\\"\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\\n\\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\\n\\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; matches current auth.user.id\\n- **Access Active**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;\\n- **User Role**: Read &amp;#96;profiles.role&amp;#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\\n\\nThis approach:\\n\\n- Keeps [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 17041,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"result\\\": \\\"{\\\\\\\"content\\\\\\\":[{\\\\\\\"type\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"text\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\"text\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"{\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"searchDocs\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\":{\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"nodes\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\":[{\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"title\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Migrate from Auth0 to Supabase Auth\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"href\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/migrating-to-supabase/auth0\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"content\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"# Migrate from Auth0 to Supabase Auth\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nLearn how to migrate your users from Auth0\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nYou can migrate your users from Auth0 to Supabase Auth.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nChanging authentication providers for a production app is an important operation. It can affect most aspects of your application. Prepare in advance by reading this guide, and develop a plan for handling the key migration steps and possible problems.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nWith advance planning, a smooth and safe Auth migration is possible.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n## Before you begin\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nBefore beginning, consider the answers [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 17371,

[Automatic Linking](#automatic-linking)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n2.  [Manual Linking](#manual-linking-beta)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n### Automatic linking\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nSupabase Auth automatically links identities with the same email address to a single user. This helps to improve the user experience when multiple OAuth login options are presented since the user does not need to remember which OAuth account they used [... omitted end of long line]"

[Automatic Linking](#automatic-linking)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n2.  [Manual Linking](#manual-linking-beta)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n### Automatic linking\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nSupabase Auth automatically links identities with the same email address to a single user. This helps to improve the user experience when multiple OAuth login options are presented since the user does not need to remember which OAuth account they used [... omitted end of long line]"

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Handles both sign-in and sign-up flows seamlessly\n * Validates next parameter to prevent open redirects\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton({ next }: { next?: string }) {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const supabase = createClient();\n\n    try {\n      const callbackUrl = new URL(&#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/callback&#96;);\n      if (next) {\n        // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects (defense-in-depth)\n        const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, window.location.origin);\n        if (validatedNext) {\n          // Properly encode the next parameter - it may contain query parameters itself\n          callbackUrl.searchParams.set(\"next\", validatedNext);\n        }\n      }\n\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: \"google\",\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: callbackUrl.toString(),\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error(\"Google OAuth error:\", error);\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n      // Note: User will be redirected to Google, so we don't reset loading state here\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Unexpected error:\", error);\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Validates that a redirect URL is safe (same-origin or relative path)\n * Prevents open redirect vulnerabilities by rejecting external URLs\n * @param url - The URL to validate (can be relative path or absolute URL)\n * @param origin - The origin of the current request\n * @returns The validated safe path, or null if validation fails\n */\nexport function validateRedirectUrl(url: string | null, origin: string): string | null {\n  if (!url) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Reject empty strings\n  if (url.trim() === \"\") {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Allow relative paths (starting with /)\n  if (url.startsWith(\"/\")) {\n    // Ensure it doesn't contain protocol-relative URLs or other schemes\n    if (url.includes(\"://\") || url.startsWith(\"//\") || url.startsWith(\"javascript:\")) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    return url;\n  }\n\n  // For absolute URLs, check if they're same-origin\n  try {\n    const urlObj = new URL(url, origin);\n    const originObj = new URL(origin);\n\n    // Reject if protocol doesn't match (http vs https)\n    if (urlObj.protocol !== originObj.protocol) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Reject if host doesn't match\n    if (urlObj.host !== originObj.host) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Return the pathname + search + hash (same-origin URL is safe)\n    return urlObj.pathname + urlObj.search + urlObj.hash;\n  } catch {\n    // Invalid URL format\n    return null;\n  }\n}",

'' : 'ring-border'\n              )}\n              style={\n                profile.team?.color\n                  ?         "contents": "/**\n * GET /r/[code]\n * Short URL redirect for QR codes\n * - If user is logged in -&gt; reservations/[code]/qr\n * - If not logged in -&gt; /rezervace/[code]\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: RouteParams) {\n  const { code } = await params;\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Check if user is logged in\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (user) {\n    // Logged in -&gt; redirect to quick status page\n    const url = new URL(&#96;/reservations/${code}/quick&#96;, request.url);\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  } else {\n    // Not logged in -&gt; redirect to public page\n    const url = new URL(&#96;/rezervace/${code}&#96;, request.url);\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\nimport { LogoutButton } from \"@/components/logout-button\";\nimport { EmailVerificationRealtimeListener } from \"@/components/email-verification-realtime-listener\";\nimport { hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users can link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n * Users with existing email identities can also access this page to add additional emails\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage({\n  searchParams,\n}: {\n  searchParams: Promise&lt;{ next?: string }&gt;;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Get search params once\n  const params = await searchParams;\n  const next = params.next;\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  // Respect the next parameter if provided, otherwise use default logged in page\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(next ??         "contents": "/**\n * Creates a success redirect URL\n * @param request - The NextRequest object\n * @param next - Optional next parameter to redirect to after success\n * @returns URL object for redirect\n */\nexport function createSuccessUrl(request: NextRequest, next?: string | null): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n\n  if (next) {\n    // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n    const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, request.nextUrl.origin);\n    if (validatedNext) {\n      // Parse the redirect URL to handle query parameters and hash properly\n      const redirectUrl = new URL(validatedNext, request.nextUrl.origin);\n      url.pathname = redirectUrl.pathname;\n      url.search = redirectUrl.search;\n      url.hash = redirectUrl.hash;\n      return url;\n    }\n  }\n\n  url.pathname = DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n  url.search = \"\"; // Clear any existing search params\n  url.hash = \"\"; // Clear any existing hash\n  return url;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates a redirect response with cookies copied from supabaseResponse\n * Preserves all cookie options (httpOnly, secure, sameSite, etc.)\n */",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { cn } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\nexport function ForgotPasswordForm({\n  className,\n  ...props\n}: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef&lt;\"div\"&gt;) {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleForgotPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const supabase = createClient();\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {\n        redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/update-password&#96;,\n      });\n      if (error) throw error;\n      setSuccess(true);\n    } catch (error: unknown) {\n      setError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"Nastala chyba\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className={cn(\"flex flex-col gap-8\", className)} {...props}&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "# Tappka\n\nTappka as the app all-in-one web app for Tiimiakatemia Prague.\n\n## Features\n\n- [ ] Authentication\n- [ ] Room booking\n- [ ] Essay Bank\n\n# Links\n\n## Publicly available\n- [Tappka](https://tiimi.cz)\n- [Tappka preview](https://preview.tiimi.cz)\n\n## Locally available when running the project\n- [Tappka locally](http://localhost:3000)\n- [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323)\n- [Supabase mail locally](http://localhost:54324)\n\n## Other links\n\n- [Blacksmith](https://app.blacksmith.sh/tiimiakatemiapragueit/runs/jobs) - CI/CD for the project\n- [Supabase](https://supabase.comorg/zjdqjjekgwwysjkouxpf) - Database for the project\n- [Vercel](https://vercel.com/spirit-of-taps-projects/tappka) - Hosting for the project\n- [Cloudflare DNS](https://dash.cloudflare.com/09d0b565479ef597d4c1bfa2062078b5/tiimi.cz/dns/records) - DNS for the project\n- [Axiom](https://app.axiom.co/spirit-of-tap-9eje) - Logging for the project\n\n# Language\n\nThe project is written in english and will be written in english for better llm compatibility.\nAll czech should be just in localization files.\n\n# Local Development\n\n## Setup\n\n1. Install git if already not installed - https://git-scm.com/install/\n2. Install docker if already not installed - https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/\n2. Install node.js v24.x with pnpm 10.x if already not installed - https://nodejs.org/en/download/\n3. Install pnpm v10.x if you didn't choose it in the previous step\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install -g pnpm@10.28.1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. Clone the repository \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit clone https://github.com/tappka/tappka.git\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n5. Navigate to the project directory - \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd tappka\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Running the project after setup\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\npnpm install\npnpm dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe project will be available at [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)\n\n\n# Supabase\n\nSupabase database is developed locally and synced automatically whenever pushed. See [.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml](.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml) for more details.\nSupabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.\nMake sure that the project can run without setting up any environment variables, this is so that we can get new T's to start vibecoding without them giving up.",

TypeScript errors are resolved. Summary of changes:

## Summary

Updated the project so buttons with external links open in a new tab.

1. **Fixed `app-sidebar.tsx`**: Added `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"` for external links in the sidebar navigation. Added TypeScript types (`NavItem`, `NavSection`, `NavData`) to support the `external` property.

2. **Verified `DeveloperLinks` component**: Already correctly configured with `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"` for external links.

External links (like Mailpit and Supabase Studio in development mode) now open in a new tab, while internal links continue to navigate in the same tab. The `rel="noopener noreferrer"` attribute is included for security when using `target="_blank"`.

All TypeScript errors have been resolved, and the code is ready to use.
